bng.text: Kedarick VI, king of Iretis, writes to his estranged wife Klytessa about the coming peace with the leonin, but outer settlements report impossible monsters whose bodies vanish, and Kedarick and his advisor Udaen suspect expansionist sabotage. Thoros Clawkiller then arrives in the throne room with the severed head of his nephew, claims the leonin killed him and demands justice.

Udaen points out that Thoros stands to lose land if peace holds, and when Thoros attacks Kedarick with a dagger, Udaen trips him with his staff. Kedarick executes his friend Thoros by beheading him, and Thoros's kin gather a small army from the settlements.

Kedarick gives a triumphant speech before the signing and believes the secret letter means Klytessa and Lara are returning, but Udaen is really Ashiok, who sends nightmare abominations to kill people at the peace meeting, and the leonin annihilate Iretis.
